name: tef-movies
description: TEF Movies: a movie and TV show discovery site (React + Redux + GraphQL + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.verify: npm run codegen && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
